items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: I mean the same thing goes true for a fellow like even Pernell, Theodore Pernell. He's had several opportunities. But I know for some particular reason the fellows never wanted to leave home.

ctx.x: Yeah, well Sidney Cate used to be in charge of the union at one particular time. He's secretary now. Yeah. Well he had a band, they called themselves the Moonlight Serenaders. And during the time when I was playing with this young group I had mentioned about earlier the program about the group that was comprised of fellows from school. Well anyhow, Son Johnson was playing with him. And I remember quite a bit about Son because of the fact that he also played with this WPA band that was organized in 19, just after…
Well we're about out of tape here. Is there any other thing you'd like to add about your own life or anything else before we quit?
